description: Colombo Municipal Council - Named a Road which belongs to Kuppiyawatta East Municipal Ward as Field Marshal Sarath Fonseka Mawatha
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the naming/renaming of a specific road ("Field Marshal Sarath Fonseka Mawatha") by a local government authority (Colombo Municipal Council). The content includes detailed property/land descriptions such as the road's location, assessment numbers, boundaries, and adjacent landmarks. This falls squarely within land and property-related matters, specifically land use and naming/address changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4). While government officials are mentioned, the core subject matter is land/property administration, not government structure or personnel changes.
